model_annotation: The chart visually represents the "effect" values for different language families, as indicated by a horizontal axis labeled with language family categories: IE-Indic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. Error bars extend from the top and bottom of each bar, illustrating variability. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," displays values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5.  Each language family has three bars representing different models: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, and mBERT-B2, each distinguished by a different color—green, light blue, and red respectively. The bars representing mBERT-L2 are green, XLM-L2 are light blue, and mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2, represented with red and teal colors, appear in sequence for each language family. The shortest bars largely cluster around a value of 1, while the tallest consistently reach approximately 23. The bars are sorted by language family along the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
